name: D3D_set_screen_mode
comment: Sets a full-screen display mode: the front, back and depth buffers, the device, and the render states the driver keeps

name: D3D_set_screen_mode_windowed
comment: The same in a window

name: set_render_state
comment: Sets a render state unless it already has the value

name: SR_driver_init
comment: Fills the payload's device table with the driver's functions and sets up the blend factors for each mode

name: begin_scene
comment: Clears to black and to depth 0, begins the scene, and draws a background image when one is set

name: end_scene
comment: Ends the scene

name: flush_blended
comment: Draws a layer's sorted blended polygons: every first pass, then the second passes

name: draw_mesh
comment: Draws a mesh object's visible polygons group by group: opaque groups now, in one pass or two; blended ones go to the layer's list

name: draw_pass
comment: Draws a group's polygons for the current pass with one texture

name: draw_both_passes
comment: Draws a group's polygons with both passes' textures at once

name: defer_blended
comment: Keys each of a group's polygons by its mean depth plus its bias and adds it to the layer's list

name: set_material
comment: Render states for current_material and current_pass: texture, stage operations, blending

name: needs_two_passes
comment: 1 when the device cannot draw current_material's two passes at once

name: set_depth
comment: Depth test and writes for current_layer and the pass's blend

name: stage_table_init
comment: Fills stage_table

name: make_highlights
comment: Makes the eight highlight textures

name: make_highlight
comment: Fills a 64x64 highlight texture

name: draw_sprites
comment: Draws a set of sprites, or, with a blended material, puts each aside keyed by its depth plus its bias

name: draw_stars
comment: Draws a star field, or, with a blended material, puts it aside with key 0

name: draw_blended_polygon
comment: A mesh's polygon from a layer's sorted list: both passes at once, one pass, or clipped

name: draw_polygon
comment: Draws one polygon as a fan, or its lines, and tests its triangles against the sun

name: draw_clipped
comment: Clips a polygon triangle by triangle and draws each piece as a fan

name: clip_triangle
comment: Clips a triangle of a polygon in the camera's frame against the planes its polygon crosses, near, left, right, top and bottom in turn, and against those the vertices each cut makes lie outside while their turn is to come; then projects what is left, kept within the viewport

name: clip_vertex_cut
comment: Cuts a clip vertex off by clip_plane_equation when it lies outside: moves it onto the plane toward the neighbour inside, adds a second vertex when both neighbours are inside, or unlinks it when both are outside

name: clip_list_insert
comment: Links a new vertex from the clip list's store in before the given one; asserts clip_list->count < 64

name: clip_vertex_between
comment: Sets a clip vertex t of the way from one vertex to another, with the attributes clip_attributes names, then its clip flags

name: SR_clip_vertex_set_clip_flags
comment: The planes a vertex the clipper made lies outside, the near plane and the sides alike, less clip_plane; ORs them into clip_planes. With clip_sets_flags clear, none

name: clip_object_planes
comment: Cuts the clip list by the planes an object flagged 0x2 carries at +0xAC: one, with flag 0x100, or a list, with 0x200

name: plane_set
type: void __thiscall (float a, float b, float c, float d)
comment: Sets the plane in ECX to a x + b y + c z + d, positive outside

name: screen_clamp
comment: Keeps a point on the screen within the viewport, as the payload's 0x004C5DC0 does

name: sun_test
comment: Lessens the sun's visibility to a triangle's nearest edge, or to 0 when the triangle covers the sun's point

name: sprite_cut
comment: A sprite's rectangle cut to the view's bounds, and its texture coordinates cut to match

name: draw_sprite
comment: Draws a sprite as a strip of two triangles

name: draw_star_points
comment: Draws a field's visible stars: a point, or a line back to last frame's place with the tail at half brightness

name: draw_mesh_sorted
comment: Sorts all of a mesh's visible polygons, farthest first, and draws them at once: every mesh on the overlay layer and objects flagged 0x4

name: sr_round
comment: x rounded to the nearest whole number

name: depth_sort
comment: The payload's depth_sort, for draw_mesh_sorted

name: texture_upload
comment: Makes the device texture for an image

name: texture_release
comment: Frees an image's device texture, at its +0xA4

name: d3d_device
comment: The IDirect3DDevice7

name: sr_context
comment: The payload's sr_context

name: current_pass
comment: 0 or 1

name: blend_source
comment: The D3DBLEND source factor for each MaterialBlend

name: blend_destination
comment: The D3DBLEND destination factor for each MaterialBlend

name: highlights
comment: The eight highlight textures, 16 bytes apart

name: stage_table
comment: 11 bytes for each material combination: state, stage count, then per stage the first and second arguments and the operation

name: clip_list
comment: The clipper's list: the polygon's corner count, the vertices left, the vertices made (under 64), the store of 0x5C-byte vertices at +0x10, the first vertex at +0x14

name: clip_planes
comment: The planes clip_triangle still cuts by: the polygon's, and those each vertex it makes lies outside

name: clip_plane
comment: The bit of the plane being cut by: 0x10 near, 0x1 left, 0x2 right, 0x4 top, 0x8 bottom

name: clip_plane_equation
comment: The plane being cut by, a, b, c and d, positive outside

name: clip_sets_flags
comment: Whether the vertices a cut makes get clip flags: set for the view volume's planes, clear for an object's own

name: clip_attributes
comment: The clipped mesh's +0x2C, the attributes the clipper carries along: 0x1 and 0x2 the passes' mesh coordinates, 0x4 and 0x8 the generated ones, 0x400 the colours

name: clip_near
comment: The near plane's distance, sr + 0x169E, for the clipper

name: clip_left
comment: The view's left edge over depth, sr + 0x1672, for the clipper

name: clip_right
comment: The right edge, sr + 0x1676

name: clip_top
comment: The top edge, sr + 0x168A

name: clip_bottom
comment: The bottom edge, sr + 0x168E

name: set_gamma
comment: Sets the display's gamma ramp to the brightness at sr + 0x15FA (the payload's sr + 0x54), where the primary surface has a gamma control: each of the 256 levels at its share of the way up to the power 1 / brightness, times 65535, or 0 for a brightness of 0, the same for red, green and blue

name: gamma_control
comment: The primary surface's IDirectDrawGammaControl, which the screen modes ask for where the device's caps have DDCAPS2_PRIMARYGAMMA, setting sr + 0x38 bit 0

name: iid_gamma_control
comment: IID_IDirectDrawGammaControl, 69C11C3E-B46B-11D1-AD7A-00C04FC29B4E
